channelTitle: Stingy Jack tricked the Devil himself - Part 1
hook: Every pumpkin on your porch is named after one man - Stingy Jack, and this is how he tricked the Devil. Twice.
storyParts: In old Ireland there lived a blacksmith called Stingy Jack - a drunkard, a swindler, and by all accounts the worst man in his village. One night the Devil himself came to collect Jack's soul, figuring it was an easy catch.

Jack agreed to go quietly - on one condition: a last drink at the pub. When the bill came, Jack convinced the Devil to turn himself into a coin to pay it. Then Jack slipped the coin into his pocket beside a silver cross, trapping the Devil inside.

Jack bargained: ten more years of life, and he'd set the Devil free. A decade later the Devil returned, and Jack pulled the trick again - asking for one last apple, then carving a cross in the tree bark so the Devil couldn't climb down.
This time Jack demanded something bigger: the Devil must never take his soul at all. Furious but trapped, the Devil agreed and stormed off into the night.
Jack went back to his drinking, grinning at his own cleverness. He had beaten the Devil twice - what could possibly go wrong for a man like that?
